idea-plugin.name: Compose Recomposition Auditor
idea-plugin.description:
Detects Jetpack Compose recomposition issues directly in the editor — before you ever need to run a profiler. The plugin reproduces (a conservative subset of) the Compose compiler's own stability inference to catch problems as you type.

Free

  • Detection of mutable collection interfaces (List, Map, Set) passed as @Composable parameters
  • Detection of classes with var properties passed as @Composable parameters, without @Stable/@Immutable
  • Detection of types defined outside the current module whose stability cannot be determined
  • Detection of lambdas inside a @Composable function that capture a local var without remember
  • Convert to Immutable* quick-fix — rewrites List<T> / Map<K,V> / Set<T> to their kotlinx.collections.immutable equivalents, adding both the import and the Gradle dependency automatically
  • Annotate class with @Stable quick-fix — adds the @Stable annotation to the offending class declaration
  • False-positive reduction: skips @Preview-annotated composables, recognizes a whitelist of well-known stable Compose/coroutines types (Modifier, State, StateFlow, etc.)

Premium (30-day free trial included)

  • Exportable stability reports (HTML/JSON) covering your whole project — share findings with your team or tech lead

All free features remain free forever. Premium features can be evaluated for 30 days before requiring a license.

More premium features are planned, including a real-time recomposition dashboard and CI integration. Feedback and feature requests are welcome via the GitHub repository.

action.description: Export a stability report as HTML/JSON (Premium feature)
